ClaimedProfile.title: ClaimedProfile
ClaimedProfile.description: Public status tracking which of the 9 predefined member profiles have been claimed with a password.

predefinedId.description: Identifier of the predefined person, person-1 through person-9.

claimed.description: Whether the profile has been claimed.

claimedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who claimed this profile.

claimedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was claimed.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Internal user record mapping Auth UID to the member profile.

internalEmail.description: Internal generated email used for authentication.

MealSlot.title: MealSlot
MealSlot.description: A weekly lunch or dinner meal slot (14 slots per week).

day.description: Day of the week e.g. Monday, Tuesday.

isLocked.description: True when confirmed and locked for the group.

decidedByPersonId.description: Person ID who made the decision.

decidedByPersonName.description: Name of person who made the decision.

decidedByUid.description: Auth UID of the decision maker.

UserWeeklyDecision.title: UserWeeklyDecision
UserWeeklyDecision.description: Tracks atomic count and list of confirmed slot IDs for a person in a week.

personId.description: Person ID who made the decisions.

maxDecisions.description: Max decisions allowed for this week (1 or 2).

/claimed_profiles/{predefinedId}.description: Tracks whether each of the 9 predefined member profiles has been claimed.

/users/{userId}.description: Private member profile mapped to Firebase Auth UID.

/meal_slots/{slotId}.description: Stores lunch and dinner meal slots for each week.

/user_weekly_decisions/{decisionId}.description: Tracks atomic confirmed slot IDs per user per week to prevent concurrent over-allocation.
